before.summary: Strong repro-first process and activation metadata, but limited false-positive controls, risk-based exploration judgment, explicit reference loading rules, destructive-action safeguards, and report coverage disclosure.

changes: Added a risk-, frequency-, and state-transition-based operating model and exploration priority matrix.
Made issue-taxonomy loading mandatory before exploration and added explicit do-not-load guidance.
Added qualification, retry, deduplication, console-noise, severity, and evidence-integrity controls.
Added expert anti-patterns for preference-based findings, fabricated coverage, unauthorized irreversible actions, sensitive evidence, and raw console noise.
Preserved the original evidence bar: interactive issues still require video plus step screenshots, while static issues require one annotated screenshot.
Improved the report template with not-tested disclosure, expected/actual behavior, conditional static repro instructions, and affected scope.

after.summary: Production-ready process skill with strong activation, calibrated exploratory judgment, explicit evidence gates, expert false-positive controls, and actionable reporting artifacts.
